scale_chain.question: What regional public-service relationship must remain ordinary and reachable?
Which civic corridor and transfer seams need a human fallback?
How do the three key areas share a reversible release network?
Where do route, status, appeal and maintenance interfaces meet?
Can a person read, enter, refuse, appeal and leave without AI?

dimension_rule: No construction dimension, capacity, permit, ownership or field performance is inferred from this concept chain.

alternatives.reason: It makes an AI layer the visible destination and leaves ordinary service, appeal and maintenance as secondary add-ons.
It can explain a release but concentrates access, redress and maintenance in one node; it must be revised into a distributed civic sequence.
It joins ordinary service, public status, human receiving, appeal and maintenance across the three existing key-area interfaces without requiring an AI layer.

rights.label: ordinary_access
rights.test: A person can arrive, ask, receive help and leave without an account, app or biometric identifier.

rights.label: accessibility_and_care
rights.test: Step-free, staffed and care fallback routes remain available through every state.

rights.label: status_appeal_and_pause
rights.test: The public can read status, refusal reason, appeal route and pause action.

rights.label: privacy_and_exit
rights.test: Participation can be refused or withdrawn, with no uncleared personal trace retained.

rights.label: maintenance_and_worker_safety
rights.test: A named maintenance role can inspect, repair, isolate and retire the interface.

shared_gates.label: BASE_BEFORE_BOOST
shared_gates.pass: Ordinary public service is visible and usable before any AI layer is considered.

shared_gates.label: THREE_NODE_CONTINUITY
shared_gates.pass: The three key areas share a reachable route and do not create a single mandatory digital doorway.

shared_gates.label: HUMAN_RECEIVER_AND_MAINTAINER
shared_gates.pass: A human receiving role and a maintenance role are named before design review can advance.

shared_gates.label: PUBLIC_REDRESS
shared_gates.pass: Status, refusal reason, appeal, pause and return-to-normal actions are public and legible.

shared_gates.label: BLACKOUT_AND_CLOSEOUT
shared_gates.pass: A failed or uncertain layer returns to BASE, and closeout removes uncleared traces.
